clips.title: The story
paras: Ziz Fizziks sends stolen Venture Company plans from Windshear Crag to Ratchet. The documents may give his rival Sputtervalve an edge.

After the Venture Company cast Ziz Fizziks out of its logging operations at Windshear Crag, he took sensitive documents, internal manuals, and technical schematics with him. Bitter over his dismissal, he sealed them in an envelope bound for Ratchet. Among the papers are blueprints for the experimental Super Reaper 6000. Fizziks hopes to find a buyer or ally willing to use what he stole.

Sputtervalve, an engineer, waits in the neutral port of Ratchet in the Barrens. He has little affection or trust for Fizziks, but the rivalry with the Venture Company makes the offer hard to refuse. The Steamwheedle-aligned goblins seek ways to weaken their ruthless competitor and eagerly reverse-engineer superior mechanical inventions they encounter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.
Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello there! How can I help you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.
They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
